title: Geometric Four-Colorings of the Moser Lattice and Ring
abstract: Formalizes the two explicit parity colorings from Dúcz's 2026 note on the Moser lattice. The development derives the exact quadratic norm formula, proves that the integer-coordinate embedding is faithful, proves both colorings proper and geometric on the entire lattice, and descends them through localization by powers of three to the Moser ring. As a structural corollary, every unit-distance graph realized entirely in the Moser ring is four-colorable. The uniqueness classification of geometric four-colorings and the chromatic number of the full Euclidean plane are not claimed.

informal.LeanPool.MoserLatticeColorings.MoserRing: The two parity maps defined by Dúcz descend to proper four-colorings of the full Moser ring, and equality of colors for each map depends only on Euclidean distance.
Every abstract graph with a realization in the Moser ring that sends each edge to a unit-distance pair is four-colorable.
